headline: Main walks again — and the arcade learned to ask before it records
lede: The nightly that froze the factory is fixed: every watchcheck pilot that failed on the old main was re-verified green locally (359/359) while the CI verdict runs, and the CI queue was cleared of stale-sha reruns. On the build side, PLAICRAFT S1 stage 1 landed on review — a consent screen players actually read, and a private store that refuses unconsented uploads twice over.

notes.text: Main-red triage: nightly #42's 14 watchcheck failures all predate fixes already landed (#1723 roster-case crash, #1724 late-seat/settle, #1727 seat/contract redesigns). Full watchcheck on the fixed tree: 359/359 green locally; stale nightlies on old shas cancelled so the queue answers with fresh verdicts (#46/#47).

PLAICRAFT S1 stage 1 (PR #1729): per-player consent (motion and voice as separate switches, 90-day re-ask), an R2 session store behind the relay gated by a capability flag, and `npm run sessions` — the admin view listing player/game/seed/length/audio.

Consent enforced twice: motion-denied uploads make ZERO network calls; voice-denied runs still upload, retagged honest v1 with audio AND the spoken-word trace stripped — words are voice-derived, so they go together.

recordcheck's 45 gates prove they can fail: --mutate reads 43/45 red (door-guard bypass lands unconsented uploads), and hand-deleting the motion-consent line drops it to 42/45. The ±50 ms clap bound worsts at 13.1 ms across 30 minutes plus a throttled second half.
